questions.solution:

• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the verb form "**been**" instead of "**be**" after "**will**."
 
• In future continuous tense, the correct structure is "will be" followed by the verb ending in -ing.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**she will be studying**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

• The idiom **"Your guess is as good as mine"** means that you do not know the answer to a question or problem. (आपको उत्तर का कोई अंदाजा नहीं है)

 
 
• **Example:** When asked about the new project timeline, she shrugged and said, "Your guess is as good as mine."
 
 
 
• **"To have no idea of the answer"** refers to being completely unaware or uncertain about the solution or information. (उत्तर का कोई अंदाजा न होना)
 
 
• **Example:** I have no idea of the answer to this complex math problem.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

• **To predict a disaster **(एक आपदा की भविष्यवाणी करना): To foresee or anticipate a catastrophic event.

 
 
• **Example:** The scientist tried to predict a disaster by analyzing the patterns of earthquakes.
 
 
 
• **To guess an incredible idea **(एक अविश्वसनीय विचार का अनुमान लगाना): To come up with or assume something extraordinary or hard to believe.
 
 
• **Example:** His suggestion to solve the energy crisis by harnessing lightning was an incredible idea.
 
 
 
• **To be superstitious **(अंधविश्वासी होना): To hold irrational beliefs in supernatural influences or omens.
 
 
• **Example:** She is very superstitious and avoids walking under ladders.
